prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: Create a high-resolution, studio-style photograph of a modern, minimalist bicycle positioned in perfect profile against a seamless, pure white background. The bicycle features a matte black frame with clean, geometric lines and a slightly angular, contemporary design. Both wheels are perfectly aligned, with thin black tires and evenly spaced spokes, creating a sense of symmetry and balance. The handlebars are straight and simple, with a subtle brake cable visible on the right side. The saddle is sleek and streamlined, matching the overall aesthetic. The lighting is bright and even, eliminating all shadows and emphasizing the crisp silhouette of the bike. The overall composition is centered and uncluttered, highlighting the bicycle as the sole subject and evoking a sense of modern elegance and functional design. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by blacks and grays against the stark white background, creating a striking visual contrast and a clean, editorial feel.
